scientific_integrity: Exact polynomial proof and standard-library rational and independent sampling checks; no independent audit, no asserted statistical or external certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact interior-uniform Euclidean distance population moments on nondegenerate planar parallelograms; optimal inverse stability only at fixed total squared edge length. The proof is self-contained; historical priority is provisional because full Sheng (1985) was inaccessible.
title: Three random-point distance moments reconstruct parallelograms and recover their area
